correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction: orthonormal disk monomials diagonalize this radial Toeplitz operator; substitution s=|z|^2 maps the radial hyperbolic bands to [0,a] and [b,c]. The exact rational factorization of a-b(a+c-b) is strictly positive for every R>0, making H(t)>0 on 0<t<1. Stieltjes integration by parts gives the all-degree strict deficit formula. Thus the simple top eigenvalue and norm are proved, not inferred from finitely many numerical tests.

value.rationale: The first middle-third Cantor annular mask is the canonical initial step in a published fractal localization construction. A disconnected radial mask can have an excited angular mode as its spectral maximum, so the identification of its uniquely maximizing constant mode at every dilation is not automatic. The exact rational norm replaces general comparability and gives a closed form with a strong cumulative-discrepancy certificate; higher-depth generalization remains separate.
